title: Use after free in PostgreSQL coordination of anonymous RECORD type identifiers among parallel workers allows a…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in PostgreSQL's handling of anonymous RECORD type identifiers among parallel workers. This flaw allows a database user to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the operating system user running the database. The issue arises when one process frees a shared tuple descriptor while another process still retains and later uses its address. Versions prior to PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.
